newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - United Natural Foods.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - United Natural Foods.

text.p: -- Robertson Stephens & Co said its analyst Ed Weller has started coverage of United Natural Foods with a buy rating.

-- United National Foods provides distribution, merchandising, inventory management and other services to retailers in the natural foods and supplements markets. It also provides services to producers in the same markets.
-- In a statement, Weller said he expects the company to earn $0.76 a share in fiscal 1997, ending September, and $0.94 a share in fiscal 1998.
